high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "astrophysics_class." The post is titled "What is One Second" and provides a scientific explanation of how a second is defined. Content of the Post: The post explains that a second is not defined as 1/60 of a minute but rather as the time that elapses during 9,192,631,770 cycles of the radiation produced by the transition between two levels of the Cesium-133 atom.
